_provenance.capture_method: copied from official Gemini CLI hooks reference documentation
conclusions_supported: Gemini CLI provides a hook system with JSON-over-stdin/stdout
All hooks receive base input: session_id, transcript_path, cwd, hook_event_name, timestamp
BeforeTool fires before tool invocation and can block execution via decision/exit code
BeforeTool is a policy/validation hook, NOT a user-approval request
conclusions_not_supported: This fixture does NOT prove BeforeTool represents a user approval request — it is documented as argument validation and security checks
This fixture does NOT prove Pokit-session to Gemini-session correlation (requires managed launch)
This fixture does NOT prove hooks fire during ordinary interactive TUI sessions
Gemini CLI has no dedicated permission/approval request event; Notification hook explicitly cannot block or grant permissions
Transcript JSON path/format is documented by third-party tools (Magia), not confirmed by official Gemini CLI schema documentation

_evidence_classification.before_tool: documented — described as policy/validation hook for argument validation, security checks, parameter rewriting
_evidence_classification.session_lifecycle: documented — SessionStart/SessionEnd documented with source/reason fields
_evidence_classification.notification: documented — fires on system alerts but explicitly cannot block or grant permissions
_evidence_classification.approval_protocol: unavailable — no dedicated permission request/result event exists in documented hook system

before_tool._classification: POLICY/VALIDATION HOOK — NOT user approval evidence
before_tool.exit_code_block: Exit code 2 = block (the turn continues, no user prompt)
before_tool._note: When denied, the reason is sent TO THE AGENT as a tool error, not to a human. Official docs: 'Fires before a tool is invoked. Used for argument validation, security checks, and parameter rewriting.'

notification._classification: CANNOT BLOCK OR GRANT PERMISSIONS — informational only
notification._note: Official docs: 'This hook cannot block alerts or grant permissions automatically. Flow-control fields are ignored.'
